title: Build isolated multiple-routine management UI
acceptance_criteria: A user can save the current generated routine under a non-empty name and see it in a routine list.
A user can select a saved routine and the selected routine is visibly reflected in the builder/dashboard state.
Rename validates the name and delete requires confirmation or an equivalent explicit guard; deleting the last routine is prevented with clear feedback.
Routine management uses stable routine IDs, immutable updates, the versioned storage adapter, semantic controls, visible focus states, and touch targets of at least 44px.
Component tests cover save, select, rename, delete, and last-routine protection without depending on implementation details.
